{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_01GeAgrsTLkdf3mNBYq9JTef","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VEcAHQP4BXx7wTpQbvSZUV","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/sol.sql","content":"WITH word_stats AS (SELECT w.wordid, w.word, COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets, COUNT(*) AS total_senses, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids FROM words w JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 2), top_synsets AS (SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) as synset_sense_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) as rn FROM senses s GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid) SELECT ws.wordid AS word_id, ws.word, ws.total_synsets, ws.total_senses, ws.distinct_domains, ws.distinct_posids, ts.synsetid AS top_synsetid, ts.synset_sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count FROM word_stats ws LEFT JOIN top_synsets ts ON ws.wordid = ts.wordid AND ts.rn = 1 ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC LIMIT 500;\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":7,"cache_creation_input_tokens":297,"cache_read_input_tokens":32612,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":297,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d064d95f-dfcd-44d7-a1e0-8f6f4dea4240","uuid":"5481ca3b-239c-4526-a3e7-698da5c00135","request_id":"req_011CbAmzZWauGLjpmcZrxkcd"}

JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 2), top_synsets AS (SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) as synset_sense_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) as rn FROM senses s GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid) SELECT ws LEFT JOIN top_synsets ts ON ws.wordid = ts.wordid AND ts.rn = 1 ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC LIMIT
